title: Worksite and park signage

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Make information visible at the scale of the site so residents can understand work and use public spaces.
strategic_value: Related worksite and park sign families can connect Helsinki projects with practical public information.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture pairs links and explanations with two scaled rows of worksite and park signs beside human silhouettes.
practical_value: Consult the dedicated sign-type guide and use the scale comparisons to judge information density and mounting format.
